content:
Alex Carter: Heads up — ACME Inc reported a large delta after closeout. Dashboard shows 18,742k tokens for Feb but the invoice line is 27,410k and a different plan tier was billed :confused: 
Marie Zhang: ugh. did the plan tier flip during the cutoff? any draft invoices?
Alex Carter: I pulled the billing export for acct acme-112; the dashboard export CSV and invoice CSV disagree on the line items. dashboard breaks into 3 usage rows, invoice has a single consolidated line with the higher bucket applied.
Jamal Ortiz: can you paste the query you used to get dashboard numbers? I'll run locally against prod-reports.
Alex Carter: sure — the quick repro is: 
```
SELECT date_trunc('hour', event_ts) as hour, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM metering.events
WHERE account_id = 'acme-112' AND event_ts >= '2026-02-28T00:00:00Z' AND event_ts < '2026-03-01T00:00:00Z'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
```
Alex Carter: this matches the UI CSV totals: 18,742,120 tokens. Invoice CSV (invoice-ACME-2026-03-01.csv) shows 27,410,000 tokens.
BillingBot: Automated note — invoice generation run completed 2026-03-01T02:05:12Z for acct acme-112; tier applied: enterprise (rate tier: E).
Marie Zhang: invoice generator picked 'enterprise' tier — why? their historical usage usually keeps them in 'standard' for the month. Did a plan change happen on 2026-03-01?
Sara Patel: I checked subscriptions — last plan update for acme-112 was 2026-01-15 (standard). No recent manual change in the portal.
Ian Gomez: check cutoff window logic. We recently deployed a change to the cutover logic for midnight boundaries (timezone aware). Could be double-counting events near 00:00 UTC for accounts in US/PST.
Jamal Ortiz: running a diff of raw events used by billing vs dashboard now. quick grep shows ~8,667,880 tokens that only appear in invoice_event_set but not dashboard_event_set — mostly events timestamped between 23:59:30 and 00:01:30 UTC.
Alex Carter: that matches. looks like billing window included some of next-day events due to a +90s skew we introduced in rolling job on Feb 28.
Marie Zhang: is that a known deploy? Ian — any job that adds fuzz to the cutoff window?
Ian Gomez: yep, I rolled a fix to batching windows on Feb 28 23:58 to reduce tail latency; it shifted the billing job's event watermark by +60s while trying to include late-arriving records. That change should not have affected final invoiced windows but I forgot to add the guard for plan-tier evaluation which runs after the watermark.
Sara Patel: ok — so billing included late-arriving tokens and then plan-tier logic recomputed bucket assignments after including those tokens, pushing acct into enterprise. That explains both token delta and tier flip.
Marie Zhang: can we mitigate? Can we issue a corrected invoice or at least an explanation credit?
Ian Gomez: immediate options: 1) re-run invoice generator with strict watermark (rollback the +60s) and produce a corrected invoice, 2) issue a one-off credit to offset the difference, or 3) keep invoice and submit dispute. I'd prefer re-run + corrected invoice for trust.
Jamal Ortiz: re-run cost: about ~12m to recompute and publish; Ops can do a one-off job. Need approval from finance/legal for corrected invoice.
Alex Carter: I'm looping in Finance. @Marie can you open a support reply to ACME: short note explaining we've identified late-arriving token inclusion due to a cutoff-window change, offering corrected invoice and temporary credit if they prefer immediate offset? keep it short and apologetic.
Marie Zhang: on it. draft: "Thanks — we found a billing window edgecase that included late tokens on Mar 1. We're re-running invoicing and will issue a corrected invoice within 24h or a provisional credit now. Apologies for the confusion." send?
Ian Gomez: please include a technical note for transparency: "root cause: batching watermark shift (+60s) introduced during Feb 28 maintenance; affected event cutoff leading to additional tokens and tier reassessment. Fix deployed and guard added to prevent tier-recalc on late-arrivals."
BillingBot: Compliance note — corrected invoice will require new invoice number; original will be voided. Please confirm finance approval before re-run.
Sara Patel: Finance: approved provisional credit up to the delta. I'll CC legal for the invoice reissue.
Alex Carter: thanks team. action items: Marie — message ACME w/ offer and ETA. Ian/Jamal — run a repro on staging, revert watermark in billing job, and kick off corrected invoice once Finance confirms. I'll track and update this thread. :white_check_mark:
Marie Zhang: sent to ACME, they appreciated the transparency and requested corrected invoice.
Ian Gomez: reverted watermark change and running re-ingest now. will post logs when job completes.
Jamal Ortiz: diff check complete — corrected run matches dashboard totals now. tokens: 18,742,120.
BillingBot: Invoice Reissue queued 2026-03-01T04:12:07Z (pending finance sign-off).
Alex Carter: closing loop — finance confirmed, corrected invoice published and ACME acknowledged. marking resolved.
Sara Patel: adding postmortem tag and will schedule follow-up to add unit tests for tier-eval boundary.
Alex Carter: thanks all.
